en.title: Low-Emissions Hydrogen in 2026: The Market Is Moving from Announced Capacity to Contracted Demand
en.deck: The 2030 hydrogen pipeline is contracting as projects encounter the harder tests of firm offtake, infrastructure, delivered cost and financing.
en.regime: Project selection shifting from announced production capacity toward firm demand, infrastructure and finance
en.key_risk: Announced project pipelines may be mistaken for future supply even when investment decisions and firm buyers are absent.
